reference_use: User-supplied images inspected in conversation for style and context; new designs generated from text, not edited before sheets.

corrections.prompt: Edit this finished concept sheet with ONE targeted correction only. In the Chair_Pod card, the SMALL side-view inset at the right has a bottom dimension saying '~0.60 m'. Correct that dimension text to '0.52 m'. The Chair_Pod header's 0.52 x 0.50 m and large front dimension 0.52 m are already correct, preserve those. Keep EVERY other pixel/content, all product designs, layout, color, typography, all other dimensions and labels exactly as supplied. Do not add any objects or change the chairs. Output same landscape aspect ratio and resolution.

Edit this finished concept sheet with ONE targeted color correction only: on the Copier's sloped control panel there is a very small salmon/red oval button near the upper-right edge, just above and to the right of the large aqua start button. Change ONLY that small red/salmon button to muted aqua #45BFC7. The ONLY red allowed anywhere is each AONAGI logo's tiny red dot; keep those red dots. Preserve every product shape, every Japanese and English label, all dimensions, all layout and every other detail and color. Do not recolor any logo dot. Output same landscape aspect ratio and resolution.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create a NEW finished industrial-design concept sheet for Seal the Deal's fictional Japanese company AONAGI, NOT a paintover of the crude blockout props. Art direction is a polished 2002 Japanese office equipment catalogue photographed on a clean white-to-extremely-pale-aqua studio sweep. Generous negative space, professional restrained navy sans-serif editorial typography, fine grey leader lines, pale aqua card dividers, very clear readable labels. Render at 2400 x 1350 landscape 16:9 or your largest native 16:9. Three-quarter product renders with small separate front or side orthographic callout for EVERY named prop; name, kept dimensions, and 3-5 short material/detail callouts per prop. All products completely invented: NO real brand, logo or model name. No watermark. No people, no room scene, no walls/floors/stairs as scenery. Small props are enlarged for inspection, different scales explicitly indicated by dimensions.

The approved room reference look is bright early-2000s Japanese corporate: pearl-white pillowed furniture, frosted translucent aqua dividers, brushed silver / restrained chrome, deep navy upholstery, blue sky reflected subtly in soft highlights, immaculate showroom optimism. NOT bare blockout cuboids. Use rounded corners 10-40 mm on furniture, 5-15 mm on loose equipment, gently crowned tops, softened capsule ends, inset panels, broad readable shadow gaps. One memorable main silhouette and one clear material break per object. Keep products chunky, simple enough to build from Blender primitives, bevels and booleans and readable when thrown in a slapstick shooter. No futuristic greeble, no excessive seams, no dirt or wear, no RGB, no pink, no rainbow gradient, NO BUBBLES, no floating greenery. Plants appear only in the planter.

Exact cool palette: pearl #F4F8F8, metal silver #C8D2D9, aqua #45BFC7, frosted aqua #C6E9E6, mist #A8BFD1, deep navy #111B38 and near-black for screens/fabric, cobalt #244FB9 only as a small accent, leaf green #70AF59 only leaves. Red #C7473E ONLY for the tiny hanko dot of the fictional AONAGI logo. Logo when requested: a thick open aqua ring with its opening toward lower right and a tiny red hanko dot in that lower-right opening; ring NOT closed, red NOT anywhere else. Bilingual product labels only where a real product would carry them, otherwise English technical sheet labels. All dimensions are W x D x H in metres unless explicitly identified. Preserve all kept dimensions and heights, do not invent new envelope sizes. Render all props from three-quarter front views, each accompanied by the SMALL front/side callout required; simple dimension leaders may go on those callouts. Favor accuracy, strong silhouettes and legibility over decorative layout flourishes.

SHEET 01 / WORKSTATION.
Layout: upper 58% has a large dressed Workstation_Bench at left (about 55% of page) and two distinct chairs at right (each about 22%). Lower 42% is four tidy equipment detail cards: monitor, keyboard, phone, document tray. Do not omit any of the seven named designs or their small front/side callouts.
1 Workstation_Bench: back-to-back two work surfaces, total footprint exactly 2.40 W x 1.60 D; desk surface z=0.74; central translucent divider top z=1.15. Two separate pearl-white drawer pedestals each 0.40 x 0.55 x 0.60, beneath diagonally opposite outer desk corners. One centre divider at mid-depth, NOT around the ends. Each desktop half 2.4 x 0.8. Broad rounded R40 plan corners, 32 mm pearl crowned worktop and 8 mm silver perimeter trim; frosted aqua 18 mm thick divider with capsule-ended silver frame. Two side slab supports at opposite ends, softened edges, generous open kneehole. Dress with TWO separate monitors on stands facing opposite users, and keyboard, corded phone and two-tier document tray at each station. Do not fuse loose equipment into bench. Label exact: "Workstation_Bench"; "2.40 x 1.60 m | top 0.74 m | divider 1.15 m"; "R40 pearl worktop"; "18 mm frosted aqua divider"; "8 mm silver rim"; "2 pedestals 0.40 x 0.55 x 0.60 m". Add small uncluttered bench front elevation.
2 Chair_Task: high navy pillowed upholstered back, softly scooped navy seat on pearl wraparound shell, silver gas-lift under aqua shroud, FIVE-star brushed-silver base with FIVE dark caster wheels, restrained arms. Seat height 0.47 m, total width including base about0.60m, back top1.05m. NOT a pedestal disc chair. Label "Chair_Task"; "base ~0.60 m | seat 0.47 m | back 1.05 m"; "navy padded shell"; "silver five-star base"; "50 mm casters"; "aqua lift shroud". Small side view.
3 Chair_Pod: simpler compact low-back reception chair, one continuous softly bent pearl bucket shell enclosing navy upholstered seat/back pads, no arms, a single chrome swivel stem on an oval/round pearl-and-silver disc base. 0.52 W x0.50 D, seat0.46, back0.86. Label "Chair_Pod"; "0.52 x 0.50 m | seat 0.46 m | back 0.86 m"; "pearl bucket shell"; "navy cushion"; "chrome swivel"; "silver disc foot". Small side view.
4 Monitor_Flat loose: panel0.55 W x0.34 H, total0.46 H on an oval silver foot. Pearl thick 2002 LCD bezel R10, inset smoked navy screen, aqua bottom status insert, tiny cyan LED, silver stem. NOT a modern borderless screen, not pendant light. Label "Monitor_Flat"; "panel 0.55 x 0.34 m | total H ~0.46 m"; "pearl R10 bezel"; "smoked screen"; "silver oval foot"; "aqua status strip". Small side view.
5 Keyboard loose: 0.44 x0.14 x0.024m. Rounded low wedge pearl shell R10; distinct keys, few aqua function keys, silver underside seam. Full office keyboard with compact number pad. Label "Keyboard"; "0.44 x 0.14 x 0.024 m"; "pearl low wedge"; "raised key islands"; "aqua function keys". Small side elevation.
6 Phone_Desk loose:0.24 x0.22 x0.10m, early2000s pearl wedge desk phone with curved pill-shaped separate handset on cradle, coiled dark cord on left, smoked small LCD and grouped keys, aqua cradle seam. Label "Phone_Desk"; "0.24 x 0.22 x 0.10 m"; "pearl capsule handset"; "smoked LCD"; "aqua cradle inset"; "coiled cord". Small side view.
7 Doc_Tray loose:0.28 x0.34 x0.18m, EXACTLY TWO open-front stacking trays with pearl/silver rear support and frosted aqua clear shallow baskets, R10 front lips. Label "Doc_Tray"; "0.28 x 0.34 x 0.18 m"; "two open tiers"; "frosted aqua baskets"; "silver risers". Small side view. One small AONAGI asset tag on bench only, no more branding necessary.

SHEET 02 / DESKS + STORAGE.
Layout FOUR balanced product cards 2x2 with generous space: Desk_Sculpt upper-left, Desk_Reception upper-right (give enough width to show its broad 4m silhouette), Storage_Low lower-left, Copier lower-right. Every product has a large three-quarter and a smaller front/side orthographic.
1 Desk_Sculpt: exact1.60 x0.80 x0.74m. A clean freestanding desk, crowned pearl-white top with R40 broad plan corners and 8mm silver trim, two tapering inward-curved pearl slab legs, suspended frosted aqua modesty panel near rear below worktop, one silver cable grommet. No objects on desk. Keep clear knee space. Label "Desk_Sculpt"; "1.60 x 0.80 x 0.74 m"; "R40 crowned pearl top"; "8 mm silver rim"; "frosted aqua modesty panel"; "tapered pearl supports". Small side elevation.
2 Desk_Reception: exact4.00 x0.90 x1.10m, an elongated reception counter with soft capsule ends BUT overall footprint remains rectangular4x0.9. Pearl pillowed front shell, inset continuous translucent/frosted aqua front band, silver top rim and dark recessed foot/shadow plinth. A lower staff work surface behind the counter at0.74m, not visible as an extra big extension. Front carries the fictional open aqua ring/red lower-right hanko dot plus exact "青凪総合サービス" and below "AONAGI"; brief bilingual "受付 / RECEPTION" may appear on a small end plaque. NOT just the logo on a plain box. Label "Desk_Reception"; "4.00 x 0.90 x 1.10 m"; "R40 capsule ends"; "frosted aqua front band"; "silver counter rim"; "recessed shadow plinth". Small front elevation shows entire front and logo.
3 Storage_Low: exact1.60 x0.45 x1.00m. Four equal broad rounded pearl doors with silver recessed finger pulls, crown cap and low silver plinth, narrow frosted-aqua upper header ribbon. Avoid featureless rectangles. No tall cabinet. Label "Storage_Low"; "1.60 x 0.45 x 1.00 m"; "four pearl doors"; "recessed silver pulls"; "frosted aqua header"; "25 mm shadow base". Small front elevation.
4 Copier: exact0.62 x0.66 x1.05m. Recognizable2002 office copier/multifunction printer, rounded pearl body with two paper drawers below, top smoked scan lid with pearl rounded surround, sloped control pod integrated front-right WITHIN envelope, paper exit recess at upper-front, aqua paper drawer pull accents, large start button in aqua not red, small cyan LED, silver base seam. Sparse rear rounded slot vents. Print on control panel "複写 / COPY", tiny AONAGI ring asset badge on front-right. No real branding. Label "Copier"; "0.62 x 0.66 x 1.05 m"; "pearl R25 casing"; "smoked scanner lid"; "aqua drawer grips"; "inset copy controls". Small side elevation shows scanner/control silhouette.

SHEET 03 / AMENITIES.
Layout FIVE complete product cards: Water_Server upper-left, Vending_Machine upper-centre (largest), Umbrella_Stand upper-right; Slipper_Cabinet bottom-left and Planter_Box bottom-right. Every named prop THREE-QUARTER with its own SMALL FRONT OR SIDE callout, plus exact dimensions and 3-5 brief notes. All fully visible.
1 Water_Server: total exactly0.35 x0.35 x1.35m INCLUDING top water bottle. Body about0.97m tall, aqua translucent inverted water bottle rises0.38m. Soft pearl body R25, silver narrow waist band, recessed smoked dispensing bay with TWO distinct taps both neutral/aqua (no red), removable aqua drip tray, small cyan status light. Label on front "給水 / WATER", small AONAGI ring asset mark. Sheet text "Water_Server"; "0.35 x 0.35 x 1.35 m incl. bottle"; "translucent aqua bottle"; "pearl rounded body"; "smoked tap recess"; "aqua drip tray". Side view.
2 Umbrella_Stand: compact cylinder0.22m diameter x0.55m high, two CLOSED umbrellas with dark navy fabric and curved silver/pearl hooked handles reach1.00m total. Rounded perforated brushed-silver cylinder with pearl soft rim and frosted-aqua bottom insert/drip cup, orderly vertical pill-shaped slots. NO plants in it. Sheet text "Umbrella_Stand"; "diameter 0.22 m x H 0.55 m | umbrellas H 1.00 m"; "slotted silver sleeve"; "pearl rolled rim"; "aqua drip cup"; "closed navy umbrellas". Small side view.
3 Vending_Machine: exact0.90 x0.65 x1.80m, recognizable Japanese drinks vending machine with rounded pearl outer casing R35, slightly convex smoked display window showing a disciplined3x4 grid of FICTIONAL drink cans/bottles ONLY cool white/aqua/navy packaging, one large recessed pickup slot near base, small silver payment module at right and physical aqua product-selection buttons. Aqua header with bilingual exact "自動販売機 / DRINKS" and small AONAGI open ring mark. Fictional drinks named "NAGI", "MIZU", "AO"; no real brands, no warm-colored cans. 2002 not touchscreen. Sheet text "Vending_Machine"; "0.90 x 0.65 x 1.80 m"; "R35 pearl shell"; "smoked display window"; "physical aqua buttons"; "silver payment module"; "recessed pickup bay". Small side elevation.
4 Slipper_Cabinet:exact0.90 x0.35 x0.70m, six open cubbies in a3-column x2-row grid, rounded pearl outside frame R25, frosted-aqua dividers/back panels, silver edge on lower plinth. Each cubby contains a pair of simple light-mist blue/white indoor slippers; no plants on top. Small real-world header plaque "室内履き / SLIPPERS". Sheet text "Slipper_Cabinet"; "0.90 x 0.35 x 0.70 m"; "six open cubbies"; "pearl rounded frame"; "frosted aqua partitions"; "mist slipper pairs". Small front elevation.
5 Planter_Box: the POT envelope exactly1.00 x0.45 x0.55m; foliage above pot to around1.20m total. Pearl-white rounded trough R35 with a single recessed frosted-aqua horizontal ribbon below top rim, slim brushed-silver base, dark recessed soil. Broad simple green leaf blades/oval leaves, moderate density, every leaf emerges from inside this pot; not a bushy jungle or flowers. Sheet text "Planter_Box"; "pot 1.00 x 0.45 x 0.55 m | leaves above"; "pearl rounded trough"; "frosted aqua ribbon"; "silver recessed foot"; "broad green leaves". Small side elevation.

SHEET 04 / LIGHT + COLUMN.
Layout two product studies, pendant across left60% and full tall rounded square column on right40%; do not crop or turn column into a light. Include small front/side orthographic of each and one useful cross-section/material closeup per object. Use strong layout hierarchy and restrained soft-aqua background. No room scene.
1 Light_Pendant_Linear: the LIGHT BAR exact2.40m W x0.07m D x0.06m H, suspended so top of bar is0.80m below ceiling on two thin silver cables. Pearl/silver rounded capsule extrusion R20 at ends in plan and R10 across thickness, silver top spine, frosted-milk/aqua underside diffuser strip with soft white practical illumination, one small pearl ceiling canopy for each cable. No bare LED points or sci-fi neon. Two suspension cables located400mm in from each bar end. Detail inset shows pill section and frosted diffuser; small front elevation with dimensional labels2.40,0.80drop,0.06barheight. Sheet text "Light_Pendant_Linear"; "bar 2.40 x 0.07 x 0.06 m | drop 0.80 m"; "silver capsule spine"; "frosted-milk diffuser"; "pearl rounded end caps"; "twin cable suspension". Bar must look slim and clearly long. No thick metre-wide fixture.
2 Column_Graphic: full0.80m x0.80m SQUARE column footprint,4.30m high, four vertical corners each radius0.06m. NOT cylindrical, no shape bulging outside envelope. Pearl-white cladding with a slim silver band/collar at very top and bottom, all trim inset to respect0.8 footprint. A single restrained flat printed broad aqua swoosh/band graphic rising around lower-middle to about2.50m; one thin frosted-aqua-looking printed edge (NOT bubbles, not water illustration). NAVY floor lettering on upper front "2F" above exact Japanese "審査部" and "REVIEW". One tiny AONAGI ring/red hanko dot asset badge at human eye level on side. This is applied graphic on pearl surface, NOT a physical structural twist or hanging signage. Sheet text "Column_Graphic"; "0.80 x 0.80 x 4.30 m | corners R60 mm"; "pearl rounded-square cladding"; "inset silver collars"; "printed aqua band"; "2F / 審査部 / REVIEW". Small front orthographic with complete4.30m height and an actual rounded-SQUARE plan inset clearly showingR60 corners. Keep pearl dominant.
